settings.question: How long should aligners be worn each day?
settings.answer: 20–22 hours per day — out only for brushing, cleaning, eating, and drinking anything other than cool water.

settings.question: Do treatment plans cost anything?
settings.answer: No — case submission is free on all plans. You're invoiced only when you approve a plan for manufacturing.

settings.question: Do plans include attachments and IPR?
settings.answer: Most plans include attachments for movement predictability; IPR is used sparingly. You can give specific instructions for both at case submission.

settings.question: Can a general dentist bill insurance for aligners?
settings.answer: Yes — all dentists can bill under the ortho benefit. Note that ortho benefits usually carry a separate lifetime max and deductible.
